wiki.title: Aaron Reed
wiki.extract: Aaron Charles Reed (born July 20, 1977) is an American politician. He serves as a Republican member for the 7th district of the Kentucky Senate. His district represents Anderson, Shelby, Spencer counties, and part of Jefferson.
